summary: Frontend-only verification of the new SELECTIVE RESTORE UI in Backup Center (Respaldo Total de Base de Datos). Built a minimal in-memory ZIP with a valid _manifest.json via JSZip, uploaded it through data-testid='full-backup-file-input', and verified all required checklist behaviors WITHOUT executing the destructive restore. All assertions passed.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description (a11y warning from Radix; non-blocking)
Hydration warnings: <span> injected as child of <tbody>/<tr> by x-ve-dynamic wrappers (pre-existing, unrelated to this feature but worth cleaning up)

verified_behaviors: full-backup-collections-list renders one item per collection (clients, banks, quotes) with full-backup-col-<name> and full-backup-col-checkbox-<name>
All collections checked by default -> full-backup-exact-checkbox visible AND confirm button label = 'Restaurar Todo'
Confirm button disabled until 'RESTAURAR' typed in full-backup-confirm-input
Deselecting one collection (selective mode) -> full-backup-exact-checkbox is HIDDEN and button changes to 'Restaurar 2 colección(es)'
Typing 'RESTAURAR' with >=1 collection enables confirm button
full-backup-toggle-all toggles between select-all and deselect-all
With 0 collections selected, confirm button stays DISABLED even with 'RESTAURAR' typed
full-backup-cancel-btn closes the dialog cleanly (no restore executed)
critical_code_review_comments: BackupCenter.jsx is ~1100 lines; consider splitting the restore-dialog logic into its own component/hook for maintainability (>700 line guideline).
Radix DialogContent inside full-backup-confirm-dialog is missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby (a11y).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral in-memory ZIP with fake _manifest.json (clients=10, banks=5, quotes=3). Not persisted; restore was NEVER executed (cancelled before confirm).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To exercise the dialog without touching real data, generate a ZIP in the browser via JSZip containing just a _manifest.json with {type:'full-database-backup', collections:[...]}, then set it on input[data-testid=full-backup-file-input]. Always CANCEL before confirming to avoid destructive restore.
